claims.text: ICI-related GBS: IVIG 0.4 g/kg/d for 5 days w prednisolone 1-2 mg/kg/d or IV methylprednisolone 1 g/d for 5 days, then steroid taper.
claims.quote: However, for immune checkpoint inhibitor–related GBS, IVIG (0.4 g/kg/d for 5 days) is concurrently administered with prednisolone (1-2 mg/kg/d) or intravenous methylprednisolone (1 g/d) for 5 days, followed by a steroid taper.
